opening.text: "Stop the press. You printed my obituary." / Maya slaps the damp front page on the typesetter's counter. Her own photograph stares up at her.

closing.text: "I buried you. I kept the death certificate."

ready.rationale: Picked by word-based rules, not judged by a model: a strong opening line and an unresolved closing line.
